Covers Hebei Sheng and Chengde fu. Relief shown pictorially. Pen-and-ink and watercolor. Oriented with north to the bottom. Based on "Huang chao yi tong yu tu" by Li Zhaoluo and "Zhi li yi cang tu" by Fang Guangcheng. Includes text which indicates the number of villages in each administrative unit and distance between villages and cities. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
